attempted_claim: Prove or disprove the following: let F5 be the free group of rank 5 and let R5 be the rank-5 rose with directed edges a1..a5; consider atoroidal fully irreducible classes phi, psi in Out(F5) each admitting an expanding irreducible train-track representative f: R5 -> R5 whose 5x5 transition matrix M is primitive with Perron-Frobenius eigenvalue lambda > 1; if M_phi and M_psi are conjugate by a permutation matrix and lambda_phi = lambda_psi = lambda, then phi is conjugate in Out(F5) to psi or to psi^{-1}; a complete answer is either a proof of this implication for all such pairs on R5, or an explicit counterexample pair (f_phi, f_psi with words, matrices, primitivity certificates, atoroidal fully irreducible certificates) plus a rigorous non-conjugacy certificate such as distinct conjugacy-invariant ideal Whitehead data or distinct attracting-lamination endpoint invariants.
decisive_failure: The reported obstruction is that atoroidal fully-irreducible proofs and the psi-inverse stable Whitehead comparison were never completed within the expired one-hour budget; the 17-versus-21 edge degree-sequence distinction is therefore an uncertified computational observation, not an audited disproof. All partial evidence is preserved in output/artifacts/ and output/target_exit.json for future work.
